user.title: Connect to Pyroscope
user.description: Send continuous CPU profiles of Home Assistant to a Pyroscope server or Grafana Cloud Profiles.

data_description.url: For Grafana Cloud, the URL on your stack's Profiles details page.
data_description.username: For Grafana Cloud, the Profiles instance ID. Leave empty if the server has no auth.
data_description.password: For Grafana Cloud, an access policy token with the profiles:write scope.

error.invalid_url: Enter an absolute http or https URL.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Pyroscope is already configured. The profiler is process-wide, so only one entry is allowed.

data_description.sample_rate: CPU samples per second. Lower it to reduce overhead.
data_description.memory_profiling: Also send allocation profiles. Adds overhead.
